items.title: Octopus Hearts
parts: Two hearts help it breathe with its gills, and one heart works for the rest of its body.
An octopus can also change colour to hide among rocks!

items.title: The Sun Is a Star
parts: The Sun is a star, just like the stars at night.
It looks bigger because it is much closer to us.
The light from the Sun takes about eight minutes to reach Earth.
